title: Meeting a classmate at the cafe
situation: Two students share a table before English class and agree to practice.

turns.text: Thanks. I'm Alex. Are you in the morning English class?
I am. I just came from the library.
Same here. Do you want to practice the dialogue together?
Sure. I still mix up borrow and lend.
We can do two lines each, then order coffee.
Perfect. I'll get the next round if we finish.

followUps: Ask what your partner did before class.
Invite them to study together tomorrow.
Order a drink for both of you.
usefulPhrases: Do you want to practice together?
